comparison.objective: Hang two wine glasses upside down in an overhead rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Fragile stemware inversion, stem-channel entry, sliding and gentle release.
comparison.success_condition: Feet supported on both lips, stems centered, glasses plumb and still, hands clear for 1 s. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Tests fragile object hanging in a channel, not collective separation through apertures.
